scope: The newest Thunderbird with Microsoft 365, a new YouTube menu, podcast browsing, and an extension that updates itself.

topics.title: The newest Thunderbird
details: Voice Companion can move Thunderbird to the newest version with one yes. It works with Microsoft 365.
Your accounts, mail and settings stay as they are. A copy is saved first, just in case.
Say update Thunderbird at any time to hear your version.

topics.title: YouTube menu
details: YouTube now opens to a menu. It has Search, Home, your lists and more.
Press Control+F, then type or say what to find. Press Enter or say confirm.
After a search, press Control+Shift+F for filters.

topics.title: Browse podcasts
details: Browse podcasts now lists categories, like News, Comedy and History. Choose one to hear its top shows.
Top podcasts lists the most popular shows.
Player controls let you play, pause, skip and change the volume, all in Voice Companion.

topics.title: Sound
details: Podcasts and the radio now play in Voice Companion. No other window opens.
They start at half volume, and remember the volume you choose.
The sound gets quieter while you press keys, so you can hear your screen reader.

topics.title: YouTube
details: You can now type a search. Letters no longer act as video keys while you type.
Filters work again with the filters YouTube offers now.

topics.title: Chrome extension
details: The Chrome extension now asks Chrome for its updates on its own.
Testers need to choose Reload on the extension card one last time.
